header.name: Experiential Learning - Creating for the Real Economy
header.description:
Experiential learning is transformative. Through this course, we will offer our students opportunities to ground their learning in real, immediate experiences that deepen their knowledge, expand their perspectives, and build their skillset especially with reference to customer interface with digital products and spaces. Through observation, it will illuminate how digital spaces are integrated in people's life and their decisions, feelings, motivation, and behavior related to them. The thematic focus areas (urban) will be the elderly, climate action and the urban poor. These have been selected because they are emerging as the powerful influencers of the strategic plans of all industries.
Using their first hand observations, students will present insights and innovative entrepreneurship/intrapreneurship ideas for digital usages.
